title: ai-rulez verify --plugin
description: Output of `ai-rulez verify --plugin --format json`: whether the generated plugin bundles match their provenance hashes. status is drift (exit 2) when a bundle differs; the error is also on stderr.

drift.description: Each path where the bundle differs from its sources, with the kind of difference. Present on drift when the failure names paths.

plugin.description: The plugin the path belongs to, for a root that defines several plugins or marketplaces.

marketplace.description: The marketplace the path belongs to (a marketplace index names only this).

plugins.description: Each plugin of a root that defines several plugins or marketplaces, with its outcome. Absent for a single [plugin].

marketplaces.description: Each marketplace of such a root with its outcome: drift when its index or any plugin it lists drifted.
